title: ConeTwiseJoint3D `swing_span` and `twist_span` behaves unexpectedly
body:
### Tested versions

Reproduced in `4.8.dev`[18a63d1], `4.4.1.stable`.

### System information

Godot v4.8.dev (18a63d15e) - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor (2560x1600 @ 165.00 Hz) - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.16.1088) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-12700H (20 threads) - 15.69 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

When using `Jolt Physics` (and `GodotPhysics3D`), the `swing_span` and `twist_span` properties of `ConeTwistJoint3D` behave incorrectly:

|                         | Set Values    | Test Results  |
| ----------------------- | ------------- | ------------- |
| Twist Span              | 90°           | 10°           |
| Swing Span (Horizontal) | 10°           | 10°           |
| Swing Span (Vertical)   | 10°           | 90°           |

I can open a PR if needed.

Notes:
- When `swing_span = 180°`, the pink cube starts to dance around.
- When `twist_span = 180°`, the tested swing span (vertical) is unlimited.
- Tested with `exclude_nodes_from_collision = true`, so the cubes do not collide.

Videos:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/29e0f9eb-b8bb-4e01-94c8-3bd26d601497

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d8ac725e-fd2b-4965-a2a8-2c51b867061b

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open the MRP.
2. Press W/A/S/D/Q/E to move/rotate the pink cube.
3. Notice the weird angle limits.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[MRP_ConeTwistJoint3D.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31655946/MRP_ConeTwistJoint3D.zip)
